evidenceSignals: T15, 2026-09-10 (Nick's adjudication of the designed boundary archetype; supersedes the round-3/v0.3 meaningful_hold_route reading below). VP/Methacrylamide/Vinyl Imidazole Copolymer (r8) is fixative-class and present as architecture, but it is ONE supporting polymer standing behind a genuine, substantive conditioning film: Silicone Quaternium-18 (r11), a permanently-cationic conditioning agent, together with Polysilicone-29 (r7), a smoothing silicone film. That conditioning architecture dominates, which is the incidental_film shape (§7.7). Coarse state only - no hold level, grade or score. Superseded round-3/v0.3 note, retained for audit: 'coarse state only - no hold level, grade or score. §5 v0.3: the vinyl copolymer is fixative-class and CAN set HOLD; Polysilicone-29 is a silicone film former and cannot set it alone.'
